_comment: GENERATED by `leaderboard.py asap7pnr --import DIR --write`; do not edit (import or run again instead). The routed course (decided 2026-11-11/12): each design's ASAP7 netlist placed and routed by OpenROAD-flow-scripts from the pinned image (score/pnr/pins.json), one run per design at its request's seed, measured and collected on a course host. This file keeps the results of the design files the task's pages show now (`of` and `record` as the ASAP7 view names them), each with its layout picture under site/layouts/<task>/. Areas in 1e-5 um^2, times in ps. Derived data, outside every record hash; `leaderboard.py asap7pnr` checks it. See leaderboard/README.md, "The routed course".

pictures.encoder: Pillow 11.1.0 (libwebp 1.5.0): WebP method 6, at the largest long side of 1600 (as rendered), 1400, 1200, 1000 or 800 px and the highest quality of 80, 75, ..., 50 that give a file of at most 300000 bytes; thumbnail Lanczos 640 px, quality 80. A few files were encoded again from the same render at the same pixel size, one quality step away, so that their bytes pass the publication scan for unwanted text (each entry records its picture's quality)
pictures.tool: OpenROAD's GUI renderer, off-screen (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen), inside the pinned image: save_image -width 1600 of 6_final.odb in the flow's routing view

course.scoring_host: x86-64 Linux, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, the pinned image unpacked and run in a rootless user namespace (chroot)
course.validity_rule: ORFS exit 0, detailed-route DRC 0, every LEC log 'Circuits are IDENTICAL' (DRV counts recorded, not part of validity)

variants.v_median: unranked extra: seeds [1, 2, 3] of the 2026-11-11 campaign, the middle run by (exact, seed); only the designs whose entry was measured then have it (the runs of 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13 are at seed 1 only)
variants.v_owner: THE SCORE: the one run at the request's seed (the seed the record names, else a seed drawn once and stored with it; no record names a seed and none has been drawn yet, so every design measured so far, from 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-13, ran at seed 1, the default) and its settings ({} by default)
